as_written_in_papers.quote: One case with low frequency somatic *TNFAIP3* mosaicism in peripheral blood (c.806-1G\>T) was excluded.

cases.statement: One person with low-level somatic mosaicism (22% in peripheral blood) for c.806-1G>T, excluded from the survey's HA20 cohort by the authors.

people.label: unnamed excluded case (c.806-1G>T mosaic)
people.key_phenotypes: not reported for this person (described only as a 'case' and 'the patient')

quotes.quote: One case with low frequency somatic *TNFAIP3* mosaicism in peripheral blood (c.806-1G\>T) was excluded.

This is because the transcript analysis of peripheral blood from the patient with 22% somatic mosaicism of c.806-1G\>T did not detect any sequence abnormalities, and therefore, mosaic variant c.806-1G\>T was considered not to affect the development of A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20).

de_novo.statement: Not reported as such; the variant was found as low-level somatic mosaicism, and parental testing is not stated.

quotes.quote: This is because the transcript analysis of peripheral blood from the patient with 22% somatic mosaicism of c.806-1G\>T did not detect any sequence abnormalities, and therefore, mosaic variant c.806-1G\>T was considered not to affect the development of A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20).

functional.statement: Patient material: transcript (RNA) analysis of the person's peripheral blood found no sequence abnormality. No minigene assay of c.806-1G>T is reported (the minigene panel lists other splice variants).

quotes.quote: This is because the transcript analysis of peripheral blood from the patient with 22% somatic mosaicism of c.806-1G\>T did not detect any sequence abnormalities, and therefore, mosaic variant c.806-1G\>T was considered not to affect the development of A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20).
The *TNFIAP3* splice-site variants c.487-1G\>A, c.805+1G\>A, c.986+1G\>T, and c.2088+1G\>A were generated using KOD FX Neo and the KOD Plus Mutagenesis Kit (Toyobo Co., Ltd., Japan).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-acceptor change at the intron 5 / exon 6 boundary (c.806-1G>T); predicted protein p.? in the batch. Disease mechanism as stated in the papers: heterozygous loss of function (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).

authors_classification.statement: The authors excluded this case and state their view in the words quoted.

quotes.quote: This is because the transcript analysis of peripheral blood from the patient with 22% somatic mosaicism of c.806-1G\>T did not detect any sequence abnormalities, and therefore, mosaic variant c.806-1G\>T was considered not to affect the development of A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20).

concerns: Somatic mosaic finding (22% in peripheral blood), not a germline heterozygous carrier.

The paper contradicts itself on mosaic individuals: the main text gives two family members with mosaicism at 10.06% (mother of patient 3) and 16.7% (father of patient 18), while the supplement gives 22% for c.806-1G>T and 14% for p.Q760X; it is not stated whether the c.806-1G>T person is one of those relatives.

The supplement says the two mosaic individuals found in families were asymptomatic, but also that the p.Q760X mosaic individual had Behçet-like symptoms; the phenotype of the c.806-1G>T person is not stated.
The person is unnamed; no sex, age or family is given.
Mosaic level was measured in blood only; other tissues not reported.
notes_for_panel: Only evidence is an excluded low-level mosaic case with a normal blood transcript analysis. The panel should treat this as a different kind of evidence from the germline candidates.
